---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature for SOSMesh
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Describe the use case.

Example: "As a [type of user], I want [goal] so that [benefit]."

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision the feature working.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Impact

**Who will benefit?**
- [ ] Emergency responders / operators
- [ ] End users (people sending SOS)
- [ ] System administrators
- [ ] Developers

**Priority:** (your assessment)
- [ ] Critical (blocking emergency response)
- [ ] High (important for usability)
- [ ] Medium (nice to have)
- [ ] Low (future enhancement)

## Additional Context

- Screenshots, mockups, or diagrams (if applicable)
- Links to related issues or discussions
- Any technical constraints or considerations

## Implementation Notes

(Optional) Technical details or suggestions for implementation.
